newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mostly up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mostly up on short covering.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed mostly higher, aided by a modest short-covering rally after recent weakness, traders said.
They noted, however, that recent rains appeared to have improved the condition of the spring wheat crop in eastern Montana and western North Dakota.
"Things are looking in good shape right now but I think we have just been pressing the market a bit and we saw a bit of a bounce at the end," one dealer said.
"I still think there is more downward pressure to come to this market but the volume just wasn't there," he added.
Volume on spring wheat totalled just 19.1 million bushels, down from 29.5 million the previous day.
Traders said featured sellers included Cargill Investor Services and Prudential Securities (1.0 million bushels each of September) while Atwood Commodities was a noted buyer (1.0 million September).

Most active September closed 1-3/4 cents higher at $3.56 a bushel and most other months also finished firmer with the exception of the spot July contract which finished 3-3/4 cents lower at $3.61-3/4.
